note: Their own published price for their own service, not an estimate of the market. Read from the page's bytes on 2026-09-08: 'SEO Audit Services Starting at $8,600/month', and the pricing table's Market Leader column gives 'Pages reviewed Up to 70 pages' and 'Audit implementation training/support Up to 2.5 hours'. ⚠️ IT IS PER MONTH. A summarising fetch of this same page reported it as $8,600 for a one-off 45-day audit, which would have understated the gap and misquoted a named company; the word 'month' is in their own sentence. The page prints no publication or last-updated date, so only the date we read it is claimed here.
